title: Google Maps Reviews Scraper
description: Collect reviews for a Google Maps place. Paste a place URL, place ID, or feature ID, choose a sort order, and set how many reviews you need.

startUrl.title: Google Maps place URL
startUrl.description: A Google Maps place URL, a URL that contains a place ID or cid, a bare place ID (ChIJ...), or a feature ID (0x...:0x...).

sort.title: Sort reviews by
sort.description: Order of the collected reviews. Most relevant keeps Google's default order.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on review pages. Each page holds up to 10 reviews.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google Maps works best with Apify Proxy. Residential proxies are recommended for repeat runs.

cookies.title: Google session cookies (optional)
cookies.description: Cookies from a signed-in Google account. Google limits signed-out sessions to the first few reviews; a signed-in session unlocks the rest. Provide an array of objects with name, value, and optional domain and path.
